# Design skill sources

The built-in skills below (in `src/local/backend/workbench/store.js`) were written for this editor's tools, adapting ideas and rules from these open-source projects. No text or code was copied verbatim.

| Skill | Adapted from | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `poster-layer-split` | [weaiw/design-to-psd](https://github.com/weaiw/design-to-psd), [1499374741-arch/poster-to-editable-psd](https://github.com/1499374741-arch/poster-to-editable-psd) | MIT |
| `illustration-layer-split` | [scort1213/scene-sticker-rebuild](https://github.com/scort1213/scene-sticker-rebuild) (MIT); layer order from [shitagaki-lab/see-through](https://github.com/shitagaki-lab/see-through) (Apache-2.0) | MIT / Apache-2.0 |
| `design-critique` | [caoxg/claude-skill-aesthetic-foundations](https://github.com/caoxg/claude-skill-aesthetic-foundations) | MIT |
| `layout-grammar` | [howardz27/poster-generator-skill](https://github.com/howardz27/poster-generator-skill), [jiemianduan/poster-style-transfer](https://github.com/jiemianduan/poster-style-transfer) | MIT |
| `color-themes` | the "four colours per theme" pattern of [anthropics/skills theme-factory](https://github.com/anthropics/skills/tree/main/skills/theme-factory); colour values are our own | Apache-2.0 |
| `digital-painting-layers` | original | — |

Licenses were checked on 2026-10-19.
